topic: ADNEX Model (Assessment of Different NEoplasias in the adneXa)
intended_population: Patients with an adnexal mass deemed to require surgical intervention or specialized oncological evaluation.

predictor_variables.name: oncology_center
predictor_variables.description: 1 if referral cancer center, 0 if general hospital.

predictor_variables.name: max_lesion_diameter
predictor_variables.description: Maximum diameter of the adnexal mass.

predictor_variables.name: max_solid_diameter
predictor_variables.description: Maximum diameter of the largest solid component (0 if no solid component).

predictor_variables.name: more_than_10_locules
predictor_variables.description: 1 if cyst contains > 10 distinct locules, 0 otherwise.

predictor_variables.name: papillary_projections
predictor_variables.description: Number of papillary projections with height ≥ 3 mm.

predictor_variables.name: acoustic_shadows
predictor_variables.description: 1 if acoustic shadowing present, 0 if absent.

predictor_variables.name: ascites
predictor_variables.description: 1 if fluid detected outside pouch of Douglas, 0 if absent.

predictor_variables.name: ca125
predictor_variables.description: Serum CA-125 level (Optional; model computes polytomous probabilities with or without CA-125).

output_probabilities.p_benign: Probability of Benign ovarian neoplasm or non-neoplastic cyst
output_probabilities.p_stage1: Probability of Stage I primary invasive ovarian carcinoma
output_probabilities.p_stage2_4: Probability of Stage II-IV advanced primary invasive ovarian carcinoma
output_probabilities.p_metastatic: Probability of Secondary metastatic cancer to the ovary

recommended_clinical_cutoff: 10% total malignancy risk cutoff provides optimal trade-off (Sensitivity 96.5%, Specificity 71.3%).
